_about: The second journal-reversal list (2026-09-23), read by scripts/remediation/mechanical/reversal.py --lane journal-reversal-2. The 45 rows REREVIEW_1_FINAL.jsonl decides to reverse (of 77 written rows whose reviewer answered REFUTED: NO while its own WHY named a failing half; the rule, fixed before the call, is output/remediation/phase3_runner/REREVIEW_1.md, the 32 'keep' rows stay written), each quoting the re-review's hand-read WHY and the reviewer's new WHY from the copy of REREVIEW_1_FINAL.jsonl beside this file; and the 8 period_name labels the period-name lane derived from 8 of those period_start values, each quoting that lane's own journal evidence, restored to the bucket of the start the list restores. The list must equal lane.REVERSAL_2_JOURNAL_IDS.
